title: Multiplication: Groups, Arrays and the 2, 5 and 10 Times Tables
seo_title: Grade 2 Multiplication Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_code: Grade 2: Repeated addition leading to multiplication
standard_text: Solve and explain solutions to practical problems that involve equal sharing and grouping and repeated addition with whole numbers and with answers up to 50; multiplication of whole numbers to a total of 50 (using 2, 5 and 10).
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 2 maths worksheets: equal groups, arrays, repeated addition and the 2, 5 and 10 times tables. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • 3 groups of 5 is 5 + 5 + 5 = 15, written 3 × 5 = 15.
  • An array has equal rows: rows × number in each row.
  • Count in 2s, 5s or 10s to multiply.
  • Order does not matter: 2 × 5 = 5 × 2.

Examples

Example

4 × 5

5, 10, 15, 20

Answer: 20

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding3 groups of 5 is not 3 + 5.
One rowCount every row.
Skipping5, 10, 15, 20 …

items.q: The red hand is the minute hand. How many minutes past 3 is it?
items.e: The minute hand points to 4. Each number on the clock is 5 minutes. Count in 5s: 5, 10, 15, 20. So it is 20 minutes past 3.

items.q: 15 counters are put into groups of 5. How many groups?
items.e: Count the groups: there are 3. 15 ÷ 5 = 3. Check: 3 × 5 = 15.

items.q: Sibusiso shares 12 strawberries equally between 2 bowls. How many go in each bowl?

items.q: 30 children get into teams of 5 for PE. How many teams are there?
